messages:
auditor-sam: Hi team — field audit tomorrow. Need an evidence package for RBAC changes tied to the 2025-11-03 incident window: rolebinding diffs, service-account to key decrypt events, change approvals, and a chain-of-custody manifest. Prefer signed snapshots + replayable proofs. Need by EOD PST.

ashwin: We can assemble that. Quick q — do you want full raw logs or signed snapshots + hashes? We usually provide signed snapshot + replay hooks.

auditor-sam: Signed snapshots + replay is fine. Auditor needs verifiable ordering (timestamps + signed manifest) and access to the CloudTrail decrypt events.

laura: I'll run proofpack export for that timeframe. Example command I'll use: 

```
proofpack export --start 2025-11-03T00:00:00Z --end 2025-11-03T06:00:00Z \
  --resources "k8s:RoleBinding,iam:ServiceAccount,kms:Decrypt" \
  --sign --output s3://redwood-audit/pack-20251103.tar.gz
```

ashwin: Also including the SIEM query we used to validate event order: `index=audit AND event_type IN ("rolebinding.change","kms.decrypt") | sort _time` — will paste link to saved query after export.

jordan: I'll attach PR approvals and the CHANGES list for infra PRs that modified RBAC. Will redact secrets. PR refs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pulls/4981 and /4952.

security-bot: Export started: job id pc-9834. ETA ~2m. Upload target: s3://redwood-audit/pack-20251103.tar.gz :lock: 

auditor-sam: Can you include proof of key origin + rotation history? I need who initiated key rotations and any ephemeral key use during the incident.

ashwin: KMS audit is in CloudTrail. Sample extraction command I'm running for decrypts by key: 

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt \
  --start-time 2025-11-03T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-11-03T06:00:00Z
```

Sample event snippet we'll include in the pack: 

```
{
  "EventId": "abcd-1234",
  "EventTime": "2025-11-03T02:14:12Z",
  "Username": "svc-k8s-deployer",
  "Resources": [{"ResourceType":"AWS::KMS::Key","ResourceName":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:alias/redwood-prod"}]
}
```

laura: We'll also include RBAC approval artifacts from the approval system (screenshots + json exports). Example URL: https://approval.redwood.internal/requests/8231 — screenshot and request id will be inside the pack.

auditor-sam: For vuln triage: note that libc CVE-2025-9999 was patched during the incident (2025-11-03 03:10 UTC). Need proof rollout reached Dedicated and Private clusters.

jordan: Confirmed. Canary rollout logs show success timestamps; I'll add a CSV mapping cluster -> build_id -> rollout_time and link to the release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v2025.11.03.

ashwin: Chain-of-custody is signed by our audit key. Manifest header example we'll attach: 

```
manifest_version: 1
signed_by: kms:alias/redwood-audit-signing
signature: <base64-sig>
files:
 - pack-20251103.tar.gz
 - rbacsnapshot-20251103.json
```

security-bot: Upload complete. Signed manifest: s3://redwood-audit/pack-20251103.manifest.json, sha256: 9c8f3d7b... :white_check_mark: 

auditor-sam: Great. Can we do a live check at 09:00 PST tomorrow? I'll be on Zoom and need someone to run the SIEM query live and walk through the signed manifest verification.

laura: 09:00 PST works for me. @ashwin @jordan please join and have the artifacts ready to screen-share.

ashwin: :thumbsup: I'll be there with CloudTrail extracts and proofpack on-hand.

jordan: On it. I'll have PR diffs and rollout artifacts.

auditor-sam: Thanks all — if anything blocks I’ll check this thread or DM. Sam
